title: CompassFindings
description: A lightweight HUD compass mod for Minecraft Fabric with spawn and player tracking modes.
body:
** HUD Compass Mod — Minecraft 1.21.10 (Fabric)**

A lightweight client-side HUD compass mod that adds a clean mini compass to the top-left corner of your screen for quick navigation and player tracking.

Perfect for SMPs, PvP, survival, exploration, and team gameplay — all without installing anything on the server.

** Features 
Feature	Description**
 
 -HUD Compass	Minimal always-visible compass rendered in the top-left corner
 
 -Spawn Mode	Compass needle points directly toward world spawn
 
 -Player Mode	Displays separate compass indicators for nearby or tracked players

 -Quick Toggle	Switch modes instantly with Ctrl + Alt + Z
 
 -Player Tracking	Pin specific players using /compasstrack commands
 
 -Distance Display	Shows real-time direction and distance

 -Client-Side Only	No server installation required
 
 -Lightweight	Minimal performance impact and clean UI design
 
** Controls Action Keybind**

**Toggle Spawn ↔ Player Mode	Ctrl + Alt + Z**

The current mode is briefly displayed in the action bar whenever you switch modes.

  **Commands (Client-Side) **


```
/compasstrack add <player>
```


Adds a player to your tracked list.


```
/compasstrack remove <player>
```


Removes a player from the tracked list.


```
/compasstrack list
```


Displays all currently tracked players.


```
/compasstrack clear
```


Clears the tracked list and re-enables automatic nearby player detection.

 ** Player Detection 
**
When no tracked players are set, Player Mode automatically detects and displays nearby players currently loaded in your world/chunks.

This makes the mod useful for:


-SMP coordination

-Tracking teammates

-PvP hunting

-Finding friends nearby

-Navigating crowded multiplayer servers

**  Compatibility **

-Minecraft 1.21.10

-Fabric Loader

-Client-side only

-Works on most multiplayer servers

-No server plugins required
 
 Why Use HUD Compass? 

Unlike the vanilla compass, HUD Compass gives you:

-Instant directional awareness
-Multi-player tracking
-Cleaner navigation
-No inventory slot usage
-Better multiplayer utility

A simple but powerful navigation tool built for modern multiplayer gameplay.
